تستمطرن (form X)
# تَسْتَمْطِرْنَ (tastamṭirna) /tas.tam.tˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# تُسْتَمْطَرْنَ (tustamṭarna) /tus.tam.tˤar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
